primitives.name: Trust-Accuracy Duality
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Our goal is provable accuracy + trust.** We optimize retention via transparency and self-awareness, not by maximizing action.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_{\\text{model}}(y|x)': 'probability density function', 'P_{\\text{data}}(y|x)': 'empirical probability density function', '\\mathcal{T}': 'dimensionless trust-accuracy divergence'}
primitives.assumptions: Model is calibrated, data is representative, and \mathcal{T} is bounded below by zero.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \mathcal{T} exceeds threshold \tau, system triggers introspection protocol.

layer2.mapping: GSI's trust metric \mathcal{T} maps to GSE's belief-state entropy; both measure epistemic consistency.
layer2.telemetry: Log-loss divergence between forecast and outcome distribution.

primitives.name: Responsible Play Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## 🛑 REJECT / REFRAME (conflicts with the moat) - 5 "Place this at DraftKings" buttons / **embedded sportsbook checkout** / bet-slip deeplinks / "make betting frictionless" — this turns us into a tout funnel that pushes wagering.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{C}_{\\text{rp}}(t)': 'binary constraint on action at time t', 't_{\\text{cool}}': 'cooldown period in seconds'}
primitives.assumptions: User actions are temporally ordered and subject to cooldown logic.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If \mathcal{C}_{\text{rp}}(t) = 0, user is blocked from betting until cooldown ends.

layer2.mapping: GSE uses \mathcal{C}_{\text{rp}} to modulate state transition probabilities in user behavior model.
layer2.telemetry: Session duration, loss frequency, and exclusion events.

primitives.breakdown_regime: If \mathcal{P}(x) is invalid or tampered, system flags inconsistency.

layer2.telemetry: Prediction integrity check and audit trail availability.

The core tension in platform design lies between maximizing engagement and maintaining trust. The 'trust-accuracy duality' \mathcal{T} formalizes this by measuring how well model predictions align with empirical outcomes. When \mathcal{T} diverges beyond a threshold, it signals a breach of epistemic integrity. This is incompatible with betting-volume goals that prioritize frictionless action. The 'responsible play constraint' \mathcal{C}_{\text{rp}} acts as a temporal gate, ensuring user behavior remains within ethical bounds. It prevents autonomous risk-taking and enforces introspection. Finally, the 'proof-of-record' \mathcal{P}(x) provides cryptographic assurance of prediction authenticity without relying on blockchain. Together, these primitives form a triadic constraint system: \mathcal{T} ensures truthfulness, \mathcal{C}_{\text{rp}} ensures restraint, and \mathcal{P}(x) ensures accountability. Their interplay defines the platform's moral architecture.
